root_cause.text: The driver assumed the event log (evl) was always allocated when performing device config restore and free during FLR, but when hardware does not support event logging, evl remains NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check before accessing evl->size in idxd_device_config_restore() and a NULL return check in idxd_device_evl_free(), directly addressing the missing validation. The CVE description states the crash occurs when event log is disabled and an FLR-triggering error occurs.
